# `aitbc explorer provider-reputation`

Get reputation information for a provider by ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer provider-reputation [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--provider-id` | text | — | yes | The Provider id. |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer provider-reputation --provider-id <provider_id>
```
